channel.title: The Traxent Blog
channel.description: Practical, no-hype guides on passing prop firm challenges, trading psychology and risk — through Traxent's evaluation-readiness lens.

item.title: How to Get Funded by a Prop Firm: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: The realistic, no-shortcuts path from beginner to a funded account — how evaluations actually work, the rules that fail most traders, and how to know you're ready before you pay.

item.title: Ego in Trading: The Silent Account Killer
item.description: The most expensive mistakes aren't technical — they're your ego defending itself. How pride, revenge and "being right" quietly blow evaluations, and the systems that beat them.

item.title: How to Handle Losing Trades (Without Blowing Your Evaluation)
item.description: Losses are the job, not the exception. A practical playbook for taking a loss cleanly, avoiding the tilt spiral, and protecting the drawdown that keeps your evaluation alive.
